content.short: Overnight Finance is a neutral-risk asset manager featuring the daily-rebasing yield-bearing stablecoin USD+.
content.description:
Overnight Finance is an innovative decentralized asset management protocol focused on delivering "neutral-risk" yields through sophisticated financial products. Its flagship offering, USD+, is a fully collateralized stablecoin pegged 1:1 to USDC that rebases daily, meaning holders earn yield automatically in their wallets without the need for manual staking. The protocol generates these returns by investing underlying collateral into a curated selection of low-risk DeFi strategies, such as stablecoin lending and market-neutral liquidity provision.

Operating across major blockchain networks including Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, and Optimism, Overnight Finance provides a robust framework for capital preservation and passive income. The protocol is governed by the OVN token and focuses on professional-grade transparency, providing real-time data on collateral performance and strategy allocation. Through its commitment to secure and accessible yield generation, Overnight Finance is empowering both retail and institutional participants to maximize their stablecoin utility within the evolving Web3 financial landscape.
